PC Errata 2017 slip of [[For Luck]]: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 22 of the sheet. Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of March 1, 2017”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf], PDF page 22; the PDF was made on 31 May 2017 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (5 July 2017; SHA-1 15433b18569a1d4cd69484e32f739227abfec972). The next edition (“Official text as of June 1, 2017”, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|wiki copy]]) prints the same slip. Shown on [[For Luck (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
